mechanism_narrative: A rise in GDP above its 6-month moving average indicates a strengthening economy, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of GDP growth above its 6-month moving average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 4% signals an easing monetary cycle, leading to increased borrowing and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate below 3.5% indicates a tightening labor market, leading to increased wage pressure and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production above its 3-month moving average indicates a strengthening supply chain, leading to increased efficiency and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of industrial production growth above its 3-month moving average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts and GDP above their respective 6-month moving averages indicates a strengthening economy, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of joint growth in housing starts and GDP (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 4.5% and an increase in the money supply above its 6-month moving average indicate an easing monetary cycle, leading to increased borrowing and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment above its 3-month moving average and a decrease in the unemployment rate below 4% indicate a tightening labor market, leading to increased wage pressure and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of low unemployment and high payroll employment growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index below its 6-month moving average indicates decreased consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of low consumer price index growth (t-test p > 0.05).
